title: Do Helicopters Have Ejection Seats? How the Ka-52 Blows Off Its Rotors
excerpt: Almost no helicopter has an ejection seat. Russia's Ka-50 and Ka-52 are the exception: they blow off their rotor blades, then a rocket pulls the crew out.
rank_math_title: Do helicopters have ejection seats? The Ka-52 exception
rank_math_description: Why helicopters don't have ejection seats, how the Ka-50 and Ka-52 blow off their rotor blades before a rocket pulls the crew out, and what others use.
